With reference to the attached communication
from the Shanghai Hot Water Shop Owners' Association
to the Municipal Council, dated April 30, 1940,
requesting that the registration certificate issued
to the Shanghai Hot Water Dealers' Association (also
known as the Shanghai Hot Water Trade Guild) be
cancelled and that the certificate be issued to the
Hot Water Shop Owners' Association, I beg to report
that both organizations applied to the Municipal
Police for registration in October, 1939.
The Shanghai Hot Water Trade Guild, 202
Kiukiang Road, was granted registration, while the
application of the Shanghai Hot Water Shop Owners'
Association, 478 Chekiang Road, was rejected on the
grounds that the majority of the committee members
are not bona-fide hot water shop proprietors.
Later, the Association established an office in
the French Concession and applied to the French
Police for registration, but was likewise refused.
Since then the responsible persons of the
two organizations have been at variance and though
negotiations for amalgamation were conducted between
the two parties on various occasions, no settlement
was reached.
With regard to the accusation that the
Shanghai Hot Water Trade Guild has illegally held
a birthday celebration in honour of the mother of
Chang Teh-loong (張德龍), Chairman of the Guild,

关于附呈的上海热水店业主协会于1940年4月30日致工部局的信函，该信要求撤销发给上海热水商协会（亦称上海热水业公会）的注册证书，并将证书发给热水店业主协会，谨此报告，这两个组织均于1939年10月向工部局警务处申请注册。
位于九江路202号的上海热水业公会获准注册，而位于浙江路478号的上海热水店业主协会的申请则被驳回，理由是其委员会大多数成员并非真正的热水店店主。
此后，该协会在法租界设立办事处，并向法国巡捕房申请注册，但同样被拒绝。
自那时起，这两个组织的负责人一直存在分歧，尽管双方曾多次进行合并谈判，但未达成和解。

Hot-water shops: Story of celebrations.

On the 17th instant we forwarded to the Council some material
evidence to support the request that in the interest of law and
justice Certificate No.C70 held by the so-called "Shanghai Hot
Water Dealers' Association" be cancelled, and that the cancellation
be announced in the press. We also took the opportunity to apply
for ourselves a certificate of our registration as a "civil
organization".

Two weeks have passed, but no reply has been received. We
are very anxious about this matter. The members of the "Association"
above named, using the Association's name and in the name of the
Executive and Supervisory Committees have since issued invitations
to all hot-water shops; the sinister object was to defraud us of
our hard-earned money. To avoid trouble we submitted to the trick.

On the same day Zeng Nyi-sei (山宜陳) and 54 others proposed
a celebration in honour of the 60th anniversary of the birthday
of Tsang Teh-lung's (龐德張) mother. Invitations were
accordingly sent out as on the previous occasion. The Introduction
on the invitation cards, worded in bombastic and fulsome language,
claimed the object of promoting public welfare in general and
relieving hot-water shops of their difficulties. (We do not know
what benefit could possibly accrue from the celebration, and who
actually benefited).

The price of Coal sold during the second period of cheap
sales was fixed at $50.00 per ton, but we actually had to pay
$65.00.per ton. Thus, instead of relieving us of our hardships,
our burdens were aggravated. It is also stated in the Introduction

日期：1940年4月20日。

热水店：关于庆典的故事。

本月17日，我们向工部局提交了一些物证，以支持我们的请求，即为了法律和正义的利益，撤销所谓“上海热水商协会”持有的C70号证书，并在报刊上宣布撤销。我们也借此机会申请我们自己作为“民间组织”的注册证书。

两周过去了，但未收到回复。我们对此事非常焦急。上述“协会”的成员，利用协会的名义，并以执行委员会和监察委员会的名义，随后向所有热水店发出了请柬；其险恶目的是骗取我们要辛苦赚来的钱。为了避免麻烦，我们被迫顺从了这一诡计。

同日，陈山宜（Zeng Nyi-sei，音译）等55人提议为张德龙（Tsang Teh-lung，音译）之母的六十寿辰举办庆典。请柬随即像上次一样发出。请柬上的引言措辞夸张且阿谀奉承，声称目的是促进普遍公益并缓解热水店的困难。（我们不知道庆典能带来什么好处，也不知道谁真正受益）。

第二期廉价销售期间煤炭售价定为每吨50.00元，但我们实际不得不支付每吨65.00元。因此，非但没有减轻我们的苦难，反而加重了我们的负担。引言中还 stated

（批注：档案于1940年4月22日提交）

that Tsang has always been respected and admired by hot-water
dealers. Zeng Nyi-sei is Honorary Chairman of the said
"Association", but he is not in the hot-water business. Yu Lien-
fa (發連俞) is vice Chairman; Sz Ying-li (禮行施),
Zing Kuei-seng (生桂秦), Ch'iu Teh-seng (森德邱), Su Tse-
ziang (祥志蘇) and Tsang Veng-moh (日文張) are members of
the Executive Committee; Hsu Ching-foh (福金許) is a member
of the Financial Committee, Zi Yen-wu (吾曼徐) is Secretary,
Wong Tsz-chi (堅志王) is a clerk, Tsang Lien-seng (生源張)
is "Social affairs adviser" (this person claims to be a
representative of Chief Detective Kao), and Ying Ting-we (華廷印)
Ts'ei Kuo-ziang (祥國蔡) and others are legal advisers.
All these people live on the salaries paid them by the
"Association" and it is no wonder that they should feel deeply
grateful to Tsang Teh-lung. Apart from the above-mentioned persons
who are Tsang's followers, the remaining others who affixed their
signatures to the invitations were compelled to do so against their
will. Tsang is merely the owner of a hot-water shop and not a
well-known personality in this city. To live to be sixty is not
anything unusual. At the present time when the country is passing
through a grave crisis, no individual should celebrate a birthday
anniversary on so large a scale as to allow more than a thousand
invitations to be sent out in the name of fifty-five "proposers",
or to reserve all the tables in the Hung Ch'ing Lou restaurant
for the entertainment of guests. No doubt Tsang was only taking
advantage of the occasion to obtain the hard-earned money of
hot-water dealers.
It is also stated in the Introduction that the proceeds from
gifts received, after deducting expenses for the feast, are to be
turned over to philanthropic enterprises, and that all friends of
Mr. Tsang are expected to enthusiastically join in the celebration
of sending presents. This statement was intended to deceive hot-
water dealers who otherwise might ignore the invitation. To
celebrate a birthday anniversary is a happy event for the rich.

- 2 -

称张氏一直受到热水商的尊敬和仰慕。曾尼塞（Zeng Nyi-sei，音译）是上述“协会”的名誉主席，但他并不从事热水行业。俞连发（Yu Lien-fa，音译）是副主席；施英礼（Sz Ying-li，音译）、秦桂生（Zing Kuei-seng，音译）、邱德森（Ch'iu Teh-seng，音译）、苏志祥（Su Tse-ziang，音译）和张文日（Tsang Veng-moh，音译）是执行委员会委员；许金福（Hsu Ching-foh，音译）是财务委员会委员，徐曼吾（Zi Yen-wu，音译）是秘书，王坚志（Wong Tsz-chi，音译）是职员，张生源（Tsang Lien-seng，音译）是“社会事务顾问”（此人声称是高级探长高的代表），印廷华（Ying Ting-we，音译）、蔡国祥（Ts'ei Kuo-ziang，音译）等人是法律顾问。
所有这些人都靠“协会”支付的薪水生活，难怪他们对张德龙感激涕零。除了上述张氏的追随者外，其余在请柬上签名的人都是被迫违心签名的。张氏仅仅是一个热水店店主，并非本市的知名人士。活到六十岁并不是什么不寻常的事。在国家正处于严重危机之际，任何个人都不应以如此大规模的规模庆祝生日周年纪念，以致以五十五位“提议人”的名义发出一千多份请柬，或包下鸿庆楼餐厅的所有桌位来宴请客人。毫无疑问，张氏只是利用这个机会来获取热水商辛苦赚来的钱。
引言中还称，收到的礼金在扣除宴席费用后，将移交给慈善事业，并期望张先生的所有朋友热情参与送礼庆祝。这一说法旨在欺骗那些否则可能会忽视邀请的热水商。庆祝生日周年纪念对富人来说是一件喜事。

page_data.en:
- 3 -

A Chinese proverb says that, "You have to urge guests to come to
a wedding, but to a birthday feast the guests come of their own
accord". As the proposers of the celebration are all intimately
connected with Tsang, they could very well arrange a feast in
honour of his mother's birthday anniversary by sharing the expenses
among themselves. There was no need to make too much of such a small
event by distributing a large number of invitations and by holding
a large-scale feast which required the slaughtering of many animals
to please a woman brought up in the country. There are now many
refugees in Shanghai; if the proposers had any intention of assisting
philanthropic enterprises, they should devote the whole of the
proceeds from donations received to charitable purposes, and not
deduct expenses. As it is, the whole affair is obviously only a
shallow piece of trickery. As the Council is well-known for its
impartiality and has always dealt strictly with all wrong-doers, we
venture to submit this report and to supply the evidence herein
given. Please instruct the Police by telephone to forthwith take
stringent steps against the above-named persons in order to prevent
them from doing further harm to the community. It will be not only
in the interest of hot-water dealers but of all local residents as
well. Kindly favour us with a reply and inform us as to how this
matter is being dealt with.

(Chopped) Shanghai Hot Water Shops' Association.
Address: 3rd floor, No.478, Kuang Wo Feng,
Chekiang Road.

Enclosure: 1 Invitation card.

(Note: Received for translation late p.m. 30th April, 1940).

C. Klien

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL MAY 1 1940 TRANSLATION OFFICE）

中国有句谚语说：“娶媳妇要请客，做生日客自来”。由于庆典的提议者都与张氏关系密切，他们完全可以自行分摊费用，为其母举办寿宴。没有必要通过分发大量请柬和举办需要宰杀许多动物来取悦一位在农村长大的妇女的大型宴会，来小题大做。现在上海有许多难民；如果提议者有意协助慈善事业，他们应将收到的捐款全部用于慈善目的，而不是扣除费用。事实上，整件事显然只是一个浅薄的骗局。鉴于工部局以公正著称，且一贯严厉惩处所有违法者，我们冒昧提交此报告并提供此处给出的证据。请通过电话指示警方立即对上述人员采取严厉措施，以防止他们进一步危害社会。这不仅符合热水商的利益，也符合所有当地居民的利益。恳请赐复，并告知此事的处理情况。

（盖章）上海热水店业主协会。
地址：浙江路广沃丰478号三楼。

附件：1 张请柬。

Hot-water Shops Association complain of competition.

This Association was established in the Autumn of 1936
in Nantao, with offices in the First and Second Special Districts.
After the outbreak of the local hostilities the Association
removed to No. 478 Kwong Wo Fong (坊華光) Chekiang Road.
Later when the price of coal advanced, there were frequent
disputes among the members. On 24th September last year we
wrote to request the Council to place our names, and particulars
on record. On 25th September 1939 a reply was received from the
Police Department stating that this matter would be dealt with.
Sometime ago we requested the Kailan Sales Office to supply
coal at cheap prices to our members in the interest of the
public. A reply (r4395 S.C. C-42) from the Kailan Mining
Administration, dated 23rd October 1939 can be produced as
proof. On 5th February this year we received a letter (No. 9615
普) from the Shanghai City Chamber of Commerce transmitting
an express communication, dated 22nd January No. 51333 商 from
the Ministry of Economy permitting us to register. The letter
can also be produced as evidence. On 20th March 1940 we received
a letter from the Shanghai Coal Dealers' Association stating
that it had obtained the consent of its members to sell coal at
cheap price to us at a certain time. On 8th April an Order
No. 245 was received from the Shanghai Special Party Headquarters.
The order explained a righteous and unbiased policy, and can be
produced as proof. On 15th April the Shanghai Chamber of Commerce
in its letter No. 1116V 普 requested the Council to certify that
our Association is a lawful organization.

According to Art. 5 of the Labour and Commerce Law,
each trade is permitted to establish only one Union in one
district. On 21st December 1933 the Shanghai Bureau of Social

日期：1940年4月17日。

热水店公会投诉竞争问题。

本公会于1936年秋季在南市成立，办事处设在第一、第二特别区。
本地战事爆发后，公会迁至浙江路光华坊478号。
后来煤价上涨，会员之间纠纷频发。去年9月24日，我们致函请求工部局将我们的名称及详情备案。1939年9月25日收到警务处复函，称此事将予处理。
前此，我们曾请求开滦售煤处以低价向我们的会员供应煤炭，以维护公众利益。可出示1939年10月23日开滦矿务总局的复函（r4395 S.C. C-42）作为证明。今年2月5日，我们收到上海市商会第9615号普字来函，转达经济部1月22日第51333号商字快邮代电，准许我们注册。该信函亦可作为证据。1940年3月20日，我们收到上海煤业同业公会的来信，称其已征得会员同意，在特定时间以低价向我们出售煤炭。4月8日，我们收到上海特别市党部第245号令。该命令阐明了公正无私的政策，可作为证明。4月15日，上海市商会在其第1116V号普字来函中，请求工部局证明本公会为合法组织。

根据《劳工商法》第五条规定，每个行业在一个区域内只允许设立一个工会。1933年12月21日，上海市社会局

Affairs issued Order No. 19455 prohibiting the establishment
of trade Unions under false designations. Besides, the Council
permits only those public bodies that have been approved by
party and political organizations to register. From the above
it is obvious that apart from this Association no similar
organization of hot water shops can be allowed to exist to
the detriment of our lawful interests.
The Council is requested to issue to us a certificate
so that we may engage in public activities. Will the Council
please also cancel the Certificate C No. 7C issued to the
unlawful organization, "Shanghai Hot Water Dealers' Association".
This is our first point.
Since 1956 when this association was established we
have endeavoured to relieve the distress of our fellow-traders.
Our daily expenses are covered by funds raised by our Committee
members; we have never collected any subscriptions from our
members. As this association has no political affiliation, we
have no social connections at all. Some time ago Detective
Instructor Ho Yi-keng (根延高) of the Political Section of
Shanghai Municipal Police despatched his representative, Tsang
Lien-seng, (生連張) to consult with us in the Ta Hsing Tea-
house and at other places, but no definite arrangements were
made. Because of this no Public Body Registration certificate
was issued to us according to Regulations. To verbally instruct
us to suspend operations is against the law. It is not for an
outsider to know if there is any special circumstance in this
case. We have on two occasions asked the Police Department to
reply to us in writing stating for what reason a certificate,
No. C. 70, was issued to the "Shanghai Hot Water Dealers'
Association", but up to the present our request has not been
complied with. We desire to know when and where that "Association"
was established, by whom its "Chairman, Vice Chairman and
Members of Supervisory Committee were elected, and whether any

x See D 8157-C70

-3-
发布第19455号令，禁止以虚假名义设立工会。此外，工部局仅允许经党政组织批准的公共团体注册。综上所述，显然除本公会外，不得允许其他类似的热水店组织存在，以免损害我们的合法权益。
恳请工部局向我们颁发证书，以便我们开展公共活动。并请工部局撤销发给非法组织“上海热水业同业公会”的C字第7C号证书。这是我们的第一点诉求。
自1936年本公会成立以来[注：原文误作1956]，我们一直致力于缓解同行的困境。我们的日常开支由委员会成员筹集的资金支付；我们从未向会员收取任何会费。由于本公会无政治背景，我们没有任何社会关系。前此，上海公共租界警务处政治股探目高义庚（音译）派遣其代表张连生（音译）在大兴茶楼等地与我们协商，但未达成任何明确安排。因此，根据规章未向我们颁发公共团体注册证书。口头指令我们停止运营是违法的。外人无从知晓此案是否有特殊情况。我们曾两次要求警务处书面答复，说明为何向“上海热水业同业公会”颁发C.70号证书，但至今我们的请求未获遵从。我们希望知道该“公会”成立于何时何地，其“主席、副主席及监察委员”由谁选举产生，以及是否有

x 参见 D 8157-C70

page_data.en:
-3-

officers were sent by the Kuomintang and the Executive
Authorities, the Chinese Chamber of Commerce or the Council
to supervise the inauguration of the "Association"? These
particulars are not known to any of us. Being a lawful
organization we beg the Council to uphold the law and justice
by promptly issuing a certificate to us so that we may
function openly, and by publishing a notice in the press
announcing the cancellation of the certificate issued to
the "Association". This is our second point.

Our members joined this Association voluntarily. We
are different from other "Association" which receives fellow
dealers under fictitious names (proof enclosed herewith) and
compel people to join at the entrance of the premises of the
'Coal Dealers' Association. The soundness of an organization
does not depend on the number of its members.

The said other "Association" first violated the rules
of the hot-water business by reducing the capacity of each
ladle from 24 to 18 ounces and by not raising the price of
water in order to fraudulently obtain the sympathy of the
public. Then, it compelled hot-water shops to suspend business,
thereby threatening to cut off the supply of hot water for the
poor. From these acts, it appears that the other "Association"
is so selfish that it has no regard whatever for the interests
of the people. The Council is begged to withdraw the certificate
and issue one to us instead. The registration Certificate, No.
C 70, issued to the "Shanghai Hot Water Dealers' Association"
should be cancelled at once, and it is hoped that the cancellation
will be officially announced in the Press. This is our third point.

After obtaining the Certificate, the Committee-members
of the "Association" one by one celebrated their birthdays, and, in
the name of the "Association", issued invitation cards to its
members according to a list, with the object of extracting hard-
earned money in the form of presents from the members. This
fact may be verified by an investigation.
page_data.zh:
-3-

国民党、行政当局、中国商会或工部局派员监督该“公会”的成立？这些详情我们均不知晓。作为一个合法组织，我们恳请工部局主持法律和正义，迅速向我们颁发证书，以便我们公开运作，并在报刊上刊登公告，宣布撤销发给该“公会”的证书。这是我们的第二点诉求。

我们的会员是自愿加入本公会的。我们不同于其他那些在“煤业同业公会”门口以虚构名义招收同行并强迫人们入会的“公会”（随函附上证明）。一个组织的健全与否并不取决于其会员数量。

上述另一“公会”首先违反热水行业规矩，将每勺容量从24盎司减至18盎司，且不提高水价，以此欺诈性地博取公众同情。随后，它强迫热水店停业，从而威胁切断穷人的热水供应。从这些行为来看，另一“公会”极其自私，完全不顾人民利益。恳请工部局撤回发给该方的证书，转而发给我们。应立即撤销发给“上海热水业同业公会”的C 70号注册证书，并希望能在报刊上正式公布撤销事宜。这是我们的第三点诉求。

获得证书后，该“公会”的委员们逐一庆祝生日，并以“公会”名义按名单向会员发出请柬，目的是以礼物的形式榨取会员的血汗钱。这一事实可通过调查核实。

page_data.en:
On 1st March, a "Members' General Meeting" was
convened by the "Association" at the Ningpo Residents'
Association. A notice regarding the meeting is enclosed
herewith. Without obtaining beforehand the approval of
prominent personages in the city, the "Association" announced
the meeting in various newspapers, and, later, collected from
each member a photograph fee of $4 and a special contribution
of $10 euphemistically called "generous donation". Again,
on the forenoon of 8th March, the "Association", taking
advantage of the sale of coal at a fair price after the
application for registration by the Shanghai Coal Dealers'
Association, first made blatant announcements in various
newspapers, and then impudently sent a large number of rowdies
to the entrance of the Coal Dealers' Association building to
publicly stop anyone without an "Association" badge or
certificate from entering the premises. Moreover, each person
entering the premises was forced to pay a membership fee of
$1.50, a legal retainer fee of $5 (proof for this is
enclosed herewith) and a refugee tax of $10.

These acts of compulsion, prompted by a selfish
motive, are not only prejudicial to the peace and order of
the community, but also constitute infringements on individual
legal rights. The fourth cheap sale of coal will begin on the
22nd instant. Should the Council not immediately cancel the
certificate (No. 370) issued to that "Association" and
announce this cancellation in the press, the "Association"
will soon again endeavour to unlawfully profit at the expense
of our fellow tradespeople. This is our fourth point to which
the Council must give special attention.

On the 8th instant, Mr. Mao Yung-tong [童永毛], a
Committee member of this association, was urgently summoned by
telephone by Detective Inspector Kao K-keng to proceed immediately
to the Police Political Section for an interview. As Mr. Mao
was not in our office at that time, the message was not received
by him. A Detective was then sent to his home to summon him
page_data.zh:
3月1日，该“公会”在宁波同乡会召开“会员大会”。会议通知随函附上。该“公会”在未事先获得本市知名人士批准的情况下，在各报纸上宣布召开会议，随后向每位会员收取照片费4元及特别捐款10元，委婉地称为“慷慨捐赠”。此外，3月8日上午，该“公会”利用上海煤业同业公会申请注册后以公平价格售煤之机，先是在各报纸上大张旗鼓地发布公告，然后厚颜无耻地派遣大量流氓到煤业同业公会大楼门口，公开阻止任何没有佩戴“公会”徽章或持有证书的人进入 premises。此外，每个进入大楼的人被迫缴纳入会费1.50元、律师聘金5元（随函附上证明）及难民税10元。

这些出于自私动机的强迫行为，不仅有害于社区的和平与秩序，也构成对个人合法权利的侵犯。第四次廉价售煤将于本月22日开始。如果工部局不立即撤销发给该“公会”的证书（编号370[注：前文为C70，此处原文如此]）并在报刊上公布撤销事宜，该“公会”很快将再次企图以牺牲我们同行为代价非法牟利。这是工部局必须特别关注的第四点诉求。

本月8日，本公会委员毛永堂先生[注：括号内中文名与拼音顺序不符，依拼音Mao Yung-tong及后文Mao Tung-tong推测]接到探长高克庚（音译）的紧急电话传唤，要求立即前往警务处政治股面谈。由于毛先生当时不在我们办公室，未能收到消息。随后一名侦探被派往其家中传唤他

to the said Political Section. There he was told by Inspector
Kao to resign in writing from his committee as soon as possible;
otherwise, he would be expelled from the Settlement. He was then
brought before a foreign Detective Inspector, who made the same
intimation. Although Mr. Kao knew that the pressure which had
been brought to bear on him was unlawful, he had to submit to
it and comply with the order given him for fear of the power
wielded by these Police officers. The step taken by the Police,
however, is an unbearable insult to our Association. We must
beg the Council to rescind its order and to permit us to
function openly. This is our fifth point.
In view of the above points the Council is hereby
requested to uphold justice, to protect our Association which
was lawfully organized, to withdraw the certificate, No. C 70,
issued to the other "Association" and to publish a notice in the
press so that our fellow tradespeople may not be further deceived.
Kindly consider our requests and favour with a satisfactory
reply.

Summarized translation of an open letter addressed
to the public by the "Shanghai Municipality Hot
Water Shop Owners' Association"
------------------------------------

On receipt of an order No.112 Character Chih
( 執 ) from the local Tangpu, dated May 26, 1936, thirteen
persons including Chi Kuh Yen ( 季克賢 ), Yih Han Tsing
( 葉漢俊 ), Mao Yung Dong ( 毛永堂 ), Yoeh Li Yang ( 郁黎陽 )
and Chi Chien Ming ( 李建明 ) were appointed members of the
Reorganization Committee of the Shanghai Municipality Hot
Water Shop Owners' Association. They assumed office on
June 22, 1936, at Woo Kuin Ying Road, Nantso, in the presence
of delegates from the Chinese authorities and the Chinese
Chamber of Commerce. On September 21 of the same year, a
general meeting of members was held at the Young Men's
Lecturing Group Society Building, West Gate, when the
Association was formally inaugurated. Shortly afterwards,
certain persons attempted to collect $100,000 from our fellow-
traders in the name of an "aviation tax". However, the
intrigue was discovered by the Association and soon frustrated.

Since the outbreak of local hostilities, our work
has been more or less suspended, because our Association was
located within the occupied area and some of our committee
members have returned to their native places. Last autumn
our fellow traders experienced great difficulties owing to the
high cost of all materials. For the sake of welfare of the
local community and readjustment of our trade regulations, we
removed our Association to 478 Chekiang Road, and continued
our work with great effort. On the one hand we applied to the
S.M.C. and Ministry of Economics of the National Government
through the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, for registration. On
the other hand, we negotiated with the Kailan Mining Administration
page_data.zh:
“上海市热水店业主协会”致公众公开信的摘要译文
------------------------------------

收到本地塘浦于1936年5月26日发出的第112号执字第（ 執 ）命令后，季克贤（Chi Kuh Yen，季克賢）、叶汉俊（Yih Han Tsing，葉漢俊）、毛永堂（Mao Yung Dong，毛永堂）、郁黎阳（Yoeh Li Yang，郁黎陽）和李建明（Chi Chien Ming，李建明）等十三人被任命为上海市热水店业主协会改组委员会成员。他们于1936年6月22日在南市吴家营路（Woo Kuin Ying Road，音译）就职，当时有中国当局代表和中国商会代表在场。同年9月21日，在西门青年宣讲团社大楼举行了会员大会，协会正式成立。不久后，某些人试图以“航空捐”的名义向我们的同行收取10万元。然而，这一阴谋被协会识破并很快挫败。

自本地战事爆发以来，我们的工作或多或少处于停顿状态，因为我们的协会位于占领区内，且部分委员会成员已返回原籍。去年秋天，由于所有材料成本高昂，我们的同行经历了巨大困难。为了当地社区的福利和调整我们的行业规章，我们将协会迁至浙江路478号，并继续努力开展工作。一方面，我们通过中国商会向工部局和国民政府经济部申请注册。另一方面，我们与开滦矿务总局谈判

page_data.en:
- 2 -

for the sale of cheap coal to hot water shops in order to
maintain our business.

Since the establishment of our Association, we have
never collected membership charges and all expenses have been
defrayed by the committee members. We never attempted to
deceive; our fellow-traders and collect money from them under
any pretext. What we know is to work hard and be faithful to
our fellow-traders.

Recently an article appeared in the local papers
under the name of "Shanghai Hot Water Trade Guild" representing
320 hot water shops, in which the Guild denounced a certain
Association for favouring an increase in the price of hot water.

It is not known that under what law the Guild was
formed nor how it hoodwinked the authorities and succeeded
in obtaining permission for its existence.

On the 5th instant, we received an order from the
Ministry of Economics through the Chamber of Commerce that our
application for registration has been approved. According to
the Industrial and Commercial Law Article No.5, there should
not be two Guilds, of the same trade in one locality. On
December 21, 1932, an official order No.18455 was issued by
the Bureau of Social Affairs to the effect that any organization
formed under fictitious names were prohibited. It is quite
obvious therefore that the so-called "Shanghai Hot Water Trade
Guild" was illegally formed.

By means of propaganda, this guild has endeavoured
to take the credit for the Association's work in arranging
for the sale of cheap coal through the Coal Dealers' Guild,
Kailan Mining Administration, Nee Tai Shing, Yuen Tsi and Hwa
Chung Coal Yards. On realizing the situation, the Coal
Dealers' Guild refused to deal with the hot water shop owners
through the so-called guild, and will announce in the press that
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

以便向热水店出售廉价煤炭，从而维持我们的业务。

自本协会成立以来，我们从未收取会费，所有费用均由委员会成员支付。我们从未试图欺骗；我们的同行，或以任何借口向他们收钱。我们所知的是努力工作并对我们的同行忠诚。

最近，本地报纸上以“上海热水业同业公会”的名义发表了一篇文章，该公会代表320家热水店，文中谴责某协会偏向提高热水价格。

不知该公会是依据何种法律成立的，也不知它是如何蒙蔽当局并成功获得存在许可的。

本月5日，我们通过商会收到经济部的命令，称我们的注册申请已获批准。根据《工商业法》第5条，同一地区同一行业不应有两个同业公会。1932年12月21日，社会局发布了第18455号官方命令，禁止以任何虚构名义成立的组织。因此，所谓的“上海热水业同业公会”显然是非法成立的。

通过宣传手段，该公会试图将协会通过煤业公会、开滦矿务总局、尼泰盛（Nee Tai Shing，音译）、元记（Yuen Tsi，音译）和华众（Hwa Chung，音译）煤栈安排廉价煤炭销售的工作归功于己。煤业公会意识到情况后，拒绝通过所谓的公会与热水店店主进行交易，并将在报刊上宣布

page_data.en:
- 3 -
every owner should apply direct for cheap coal at the rate
of $100 per ton. We are very grateful to the Coal Dealers'
Guild.
We hereby declare that we will sincerely struggle
hard for the benefit of our fellow-traders, and hope that
they will not squander their money for nothing and refrain
from being exploited.
Chi Chien Ming
Yih Han Tsing
Yoeh Li Yang
Mao Yung Dong
Members of the Standing Committee
February 15, 1940.
page_data.zh:
- 3 -
每位店主应直接申请廉价煤炭，价格为每吨100元。我们对煤业公会深表感激。
我们在此声明，我们将真诚地为同行的利益而努力奋斗，希望他们不要白白浪费金钱，避免受到剥削。
季建明

Shanghai Municipality Hot Water Shop Owners' Association,
478 Chekiang Road - letter addressed to S.M.C. criticizing
the Police for failing to register the association.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

With reference to the attached letter dated December
25, 1939, addressed by the so-called "Shanghai Municipality
Hot Water Shop Owners' Association", 478 Chekiang Road, to
the S.M.C., criticising the authorities for failing to grant
registration to the association and opposing the "Shanghai
Municipality Hot Water Trade Guild" at 202 Kinkiang Road, it
will be recalled that the association on October 5, 1939,
applied to the Municipal Police for registration. The
registration was refused and the association was on October
20 ordered to cease functioning in view of the fact that all
the members have their business in the French Concession and
that out of the thirteen committee members appointed prior to
the hostilities, only six actually served in the association
and of these six, only two are actually in the hot water trade.
These two persons even refused to carry out a reorganization,
apparently having the intention of monopolizing the association
affairs. Another point is that these thirteen persons were
appointed by the now defunct Shanghai Tangpu on June 22, 1936
to reorganize the association owing to defects in administration,
but the reorganization had not been completed by the latter
part of 1937, when the National Army left Shanghai and the
association was compelled to suspend functioning. The association
was therefore not actually registered with the Chinese authorities.
Following failure to obtain registration from the Settlement
authorities, the operators of the association established an
office at Lane 263, Zi Rue Lafayette, and in December, 1939,
applied to the French Police for registration. The application
was likewise turned down by the French Police and the association
was on December 21, 1939, ordered to close down.

关于附上的所谓“上海市热水店业主协会”（浙江路478号）于1939年12月25日致工部局的信函，该信批评当局未给予协会注册，并反对位于九江路202号的“上海市热水业同业公会”，回想起来，该协会曾于1939年10月5日向工部局警务处申请注册。注册被拒，鉴于所有成员的业务均在法租界，且在战前任命的十三名委员会成员中，只有六人实际在协会任职，而这六人中只有两人真正从事热水行业，该协会于10月20日被勒令停止活动。这两人甚至拒绝进行改组，显然有意垄断协会事务。另一点是，这十三人是由现已不存在的上海塘浦于1936年6月22日任命的，目的是因管理缺陷而改组协会，但到1937年下半年，当国军撤离上海时，改组尚未完成，协会被迫停止运作。因此，该协会实际上并未在中国当局注册。在向租界当局申请注册失败后，协会经营者在拉斐特路（Rue Lafayette，原文误作Zi Rue Lafayette）263弄设立了办事处，并于1939年12月向法租界警方申请注册。该申请同样被法租界警方驳回，协会于1939年12月21日被勒令关闭。

Standing Committee of the Shanghai Municipality Hot Water-
Keepers' Guild, which is intended to counteract the notice
issued by the bogus Hot Water Shop-Keepers' Guild, appeared
in the "Sin Wan Pao" on January 10 :-
The warning given in the notice of the Shanghai
Municipality Hot Water Shop-Keepers' Guild which appeared
in the local press is ridiculous and is not worth any
argument. For the sake of the welfare of fellow shop-
keepers, we desire to make the matter clear to the public.
Since the inauguration of this guild we have rendered
upright service for many years. We have no background
and we have never tried to collect any membership fee,

by means of fraud. The officers-in-charge of the business
offices of this guild in the 1st and 2nd Special Districts
are responsible for the running expenses of this guild.
This clearly shows that we have no other motive than the
promotion of the welfare of our fellow shop-keepers.
The shameless behaviour of the said guild is too obvious

Ta Kung Pao and other local newspapers:-

MEETING OF HOT WATER SHOP-KEEPERS ASSOCIATION

Mou Yung Tang (毛永堂) and other members of
the Readjustment Committee of the Shanghai Municipality
Hot Water Shop-Keepers' Association held an informal
meeting yesterday and passed the following resolutions:-

1. That the thirteen members of the Readjustment Committee
of the Association advance money to pay the expenses
of the Association for the time being.

2. That when the members of the Readjustment Committee
of the Association have assumed office, a demand for
a reduction in the water charge be made.

3. That the members of the Committee assume their office
on June 3, that the superior authorities be requested
to send deputies to supervise the function.
